# Ruckig 0.15.3

Source: https://github.com/pantor/ruckig/tree/v0.15.3

License: [MIT](LICENSE). The upstream headers and C++ sources are unmodified.
Archive SHA-256: `f3b1e084e2343d5a6e4d80fb0054dceaeaf168235116f792b89d98bb2da6980b`.

`common/ruckig.cmake` compiles the local state-to-state calculator. Trajectory
segments are calculated on the control computer. The cloud client and Python
wrapper are not compiled. No download is needed during a build.
